name: vivid-firestore-rules-tests
description: Tests de firestore.rules contra el emulador de Firestore (CI)
test: VIVID_LOG="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_rules.log"; node --test rules.test.js > "$VIVID_LOG" 2>&1; VIVID_CODE=$?; cat "$VIVID_LOG"; if [ "$VIVID_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then grep -nE 'not ok|✖|# fail [1-9]|AssertionError|failureType' "$VIVID_LOG" | head -20 > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_fail.txt" || true; if [ -n "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" ]; then { echo '## Tests de reglas fallidos'; echo '```'; cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_fail.txt"; echo '```'; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; VIVID_N=0; while IFS= read -r VIVID_LINE && [ "$VIVID_N" -lt 10 ]; do printf '::error title=rules::%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$VIVID_LINE" | sed 's/%/%25/g' | cut -c1-230)"; VIVID_N=$((VIVID_N + 1)); done < "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_fail.txt"; fi; exit "$VIVID_CODE"
